# EvCheckbox

> A checkbox lets users select one or more options from a set, or toggle a single setting on or off. It supports checked, unchecked, indeterminate, disabled, and error states.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:checkbox` |
| Layer | Atom (`src/atoms`) |
| Import | `import { EvCheckbox } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvCheckbox>` or `<ev-checkbox>` |
| Source | `src/atoms/checkbox/EvCheckbox.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the inner `<input class="ev-checkbox__input">`, not the root |

## Example

```vue
<EvCheckbox
  label="Setuju dengan syarat"
  subtext="Wajib dicentang"
/>
```

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Checkbox**, frame `3931:58016` (Checkbox). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Use to select one or more options from a list (multi-select).
- Use to toggle a single independent setting on or off.
- Use the indeterminate state for a parent of a partially-selected group.
- Add a subtext for a short helper or description under the label.

### When not to use

- Don't use for a single instant on/off  →  use Toggle (`evoq-ui:toggle`)
- Don't use for mutually exclusive options  →  use Radio (`evoq-ui:radio`)
- Don't use for one pick among many  →  use Select
- Don't use as a primary action  →  use Button (`evoq-ui:button`)

### Do

- Keep labels short and describe what selecting does
- Use indeterminate only on a parent of a group
- Group related checkboxes vertically
- Make both label and box part of the click target

### Don't

- Write long sentences as a checkbox label
- Use the checked state to trigger navigation
- Rely on color alone to signal an error
- Nest unrelated options under one parent

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvCheckbox`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the inner `<input class="ev-checkbox__input">`, not the root.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:checkbox` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
